entries.say.variants.default: Still holding my ground, {addressee.name}, caught a hit and keeping eyes forward.
entries.reply.patched_push_on.say.variants.defau: Dressings are tight, {addressee.name}. Stay on my side and we'll sweep the rest of them.
entries.reply.ordered_fallback.say.variants.defa: Alright, backing up two steps behind you, {addressee.name}. Cover me while I catch my breath!
entries.reply.covered_for_treatment.say.variants: Thanks, {addressee.name}! Keep them off my back while I tie off this open bleed.
entries.reply.reassured_bond.say.variants.defaul: Heard you loud and clear, {addressee.name}. Still breathing, still swinging beside you.
entries.reply.bite_non_lethal_stabilized.say.var: Thank god saliva doesn't carry it here, {addressee.name}. Still stings awful, wrapping it tight now.
entries.reply.bite_quarantined.say.variants.defa: I know the rules, {addressee.name}. Help me clear the stragglers and I'll stay apart from the group.
entries.reply.bite_psychopath_threatened.say.var: Keep that barrel down, {addressee.name}! We finish clearing the dead before anyone talks about executions.
entries.reply.refused.say.variants.default: Save the talk for when there aren't teeth snapping in our faces!
